admission.justification: An environment-clearing test or child could otherwise overwrite the real installation settings.

applicability: All settings-path mutations in repository pytest tests and shared test support.
conditions: A write must resolve the guarded path before creating its parent, replacing or unlinking settings.
The account-default home check does not depend on the environment or monkeypatches a test leaves.
exclusions: Deliberately lifting filesystem protection is not a security sandbox guarantee.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_user_settings_guard.py (the three tests named in found_at); notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/repair-r1/by-finding-on-the-successor.txt; notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/260928-MIK-L113-repair-of-round-1-attempt-A2-37.md, section 2

statement: Under pytest every write of the user's settings path in `mcp/tests` and `mcp/test_support` goes through one guard, which refuses the account's real settings path before anything is written, also with the environment cleared, with patches stopped and in a child process.
